Kitchens / Praha · Vinohrady

Vinohrady Kitchen

A kitchen shaped around everyday life in a Prague apartment.

The approach

A place for cooking, gathering and the small routines of home.

We approach the kitchen as part of the whole apartment: considering movement, storage and the relationship between the working area and the rest of the room.

Cabinet proportions, worktop space and appliance positions are considered together. The finished palette is selected with the client, from the first samples to the final hardware.
